in_greek.name: Φραγκισσα
in_greek.long_meaning: A name of Greek origin, 'Φραγκισσα' (Phangissa) could be derived from the Greek words 'φραγγος' (phrangos), meaning 'strong' or 'robust', and 'σσα' (ssa), meaning 'fragrant'. In the context of the Bible, this name would represent a strong and fragrant woman.

in_latin.name: Franciscusca
in_latin.long_meaning: A name of Latin origin, 'Franciscusca' could be derived from the Latin words 'Franciscus' (Francis), meaning 'free man', and the suffix '-sca', meaning 'woman'. In the context of the Bible, this name would represent the idea of a free and noble woman.
